understand.zh: 相反，要完整倾听他们的顾虑，努力理解他们的视角，并在后续讨论中把他们的顾虑（以及可能的补救办法）纳入进来。

unfortunately.en: Unfortunately, I forgot my cell phone at home today.
unfortunately.zh: 不幸地, 今天早上我忘带手机了。

university.en: Ohio State University allowed its students to navigate the Oval, a lawn in the centre of campus, freely, then proceeded to pave the desire paths, creating a web of effective routes students had established.
university.zh: 俄亥俄州立大学让学生自由穿行校园中央的椭圆形草坪，随后把踩出来的小径铺成路，形成由学生自发走出的高效路线网。

unlike.en: The fact is, unlike those large, city-produced music festivals, your neighborhood street festivals receive no city funding and rely on a combination of sponsorships, vendor fees and gate donations to cover their costs.
unlike.zh: 事实上，与那些由市政府主办的大型音乐节不同，社区街头节日拿不到市政拨款，只能靠赞助、摊位费和入口捐款来覆盖开销。

unlikely.en: The project seemed unlikely to succeed.
unlikely.zh: 这个项目的成功似乎不大可能发生成功( 这个项目似乎难以成功)。

upgrade.en: One of the most important changes the upgrades will bring is the segregation of the high-speed line from the regular one in certain urban centres through the construction of underground rail links.
upgrade.zh: 升级带来的最重要变化之一，是在部分城市中心通过修建地下联络线，把高铁线路与普通线路分隔开来。

urban.en: To help improve HAPs, urban planner Rajashree Kotharkar's team is working on a model plan that outlines best practices and could be adapted to local conditions.
urban.zh: 为帮助改进高温行动计划，城市规划师拉贾什里·科塔尔卡的团队正在制定一份示范计划，其中概述最佳做法，并可按当地条件调整。

usage.en: It's up to us to navigate its usage cautiously so it supports us without compromising our privacy.
usage.zh: 我们需要谨慎地驾驭它的使用，让它既能支持我们，又不损害我们的隐私。

utmost.en: That was the utmost they could do.

vanity.zh: 充满虚荣的浮华世界( 名利场)

variation.en: a kind of variation of language

vary.zh: 在大小和颜色上都不同

vehicle.en: Language is the vehicle of thought.
vehicle.zh: 语言是表达思想的工具。

verbal.zh: 有良好的语言表达能力

verify.en: verify the source of the information

version.en: the latest version of the software package
version.zh: 这个软件包的最新版本

very.en: But the reality is that your boss might view you very highly.
very.zh: 但现实可能是，老板其实很看重你。

via.en: U.S. customers historically tipped people they assumed were earning most of their income via tips, such as restaurant servers earning less than the minimum wage.

victim.en: There are so many products out there, being promoted with huge advertising and marketing budgets, that it's easy to fall victim.
victim.zh: 市面上的产品如此之多，又都靠巨额广告和营销预算推广，人很容易上当。

view.en: But the reality is that your boss might view you very highly.
view.zh: 但现实可能是，老板其实很看重你。

violence.en: the growing problem of domestic violence
violence.zh: 日趋严重的家庭暴力问题

virgin.en: The Virgin Mary is the mother of Jesus
virgin.zh: 圣母玛利亚是耶稣的母亲

virtual.en: As desire paths criss-cross through both physical and virtual landscapes, they stand as a proof of the collective insistence on forging unconventional routes and embracing the spirit of communal choice.
virtual.zh: 当踩踏小径纵横交错于现实与虚拟空间，它们证明了人们坚持开辟非常规路线、拥抱共同选择精神的集体意志。

visit.en: There is an overall decline in visits and many are struggling as local authorities come under continued financial pressure.
visit.zh: 到访量整体下滑，随着地方政府持续面临财政压力，许多图书馆举步维艰。

visual.en: This clash highlights an ongoing struggle between the organic, user-driven evolution of public spaces and the desire for a visually curated and controlled urban environment.
visual.zh: 这种冲突凸显了一场持续的拉锯：一边是公共空间自然生长、由使用者驱动的演变，一边是对视觉上精心设计、可控的城市环境的追求。

vital.en: Tipping has always been a vital source of income for workers in historically tipped services, like restaurants, where the tipped minimum wage can be as low as US $2.13 an hour.
vital.zh: 对历来收小费的服务业从业者而言，小费一直是重要收入来源；比如在餐厅，靠小费的最低工资可低至每小时 2.13 美元。

vocal.zh: 一位直言不讳的批评者

volcano.zh: 一座活火山( 会喷发的火山)

volunteer.en: volunteer to answer the teacher's question

wage.en: U.S. customers historically tipped people they assumed were earning most of their income via tips, such as restaurant servers earning less than the minimum wage.

ward.en: Nagpur's plan, for instance, calls for hospitals to set aside "cold wards" in the summer for treating heatstroke patients, and advises builders to give construction laborers a break from work on very hot days.
ward.zh: 以那格浦尔的计划为例，它要求医院在夏季预留「低温病房」收治中暑病人，并建议建筑商在酷热天气让建筑工人停工休息。

warrant.zh: 逮捕许可证( 逮捕令)

weekend.en: Similarly, in the case of your friends cancelling, perhaps they both felt unwell that weekend or they just changed their minds.
weekend.zh: 同样地，朋友取消聚会，也许只是那个周末两人都不舒服，或者他们改主意了。

weigh.en: weigh the benefits against the cost

whereas.en: Some people like coffee, whereas others like tea.
whereas.zh: 有人喜欢咖啡, 然而也有人喜欢茶。

wisdom.zh: 一位有智慧的女子( 才女)

worldwide.zh: 他们的产品在世界各地销售

worm.en: The early bird catches the worm.
worm.zh: 早起的鸟儿有虫吃( 捷足先登)。

worthwhile.en: It is worthwhile to find a good way to learn.
worthwhile.zh: 找到一种好的学习方法是值得的。

worthy.en: a worthy member of the team

writing.en: Because writing a new script-literally or figuratively-means that other team members will have to adapt to something new.
writing.zh: 因为写一套新脚本——无论是字面意义还是比喻意义——都意味着其他团队成员必须适应新东西。

wrong.en: Instead of saying what is wrong, broken, or suboptimal, talk about what is right, fixable, or ideal.
wrong.zh: 与其说哪里错了、坏了、不够好，不如谈论什么是对的、可修复的、理想的。

yesterday.en: The reality is startlingly different, as I discovered when the culture department commissioned me to conduct an independent review of English public libraries, published yesterday.
yesterday.zh: 现实情况却截然不同——我受文化部门委托对英格兰公共图书馆开展独立调研，报告已于昨日发布。

yield.en: improve the yield of the crop
